subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) Computer is a (i) an indispensable part in our day to day life. (b) It has become (ii) modern electronic device. (c) Computer is of great (iii) is not a new thing use (d) The invention (iv) about by computer. (e) Drastic change has (v) ultra solar device brought (vi) has a long history. (vii) to us
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (ii) Computer is a modern electronic device. (b) + (i) It has become an indispensable part in our day to day life. (c) + (vii) Computer is of great use to us. (d) + (vi) The invention has a long history. (e) + (iv) Drastic change has been brought about by computer.
